nodes.label: Fold Design Sensitivity (n_folds and fold seed)
nodes.norm_label: fold design sensitivity (n_folds and fold seed)
nodes.rationale: Holds tuned covariates and hyperparameters fixed while varying fold count and fold seeds so that the effect of fold composition and train size on R2/RMSE can be isolated cheaply without re-tuning, justifying the chosen fold design.

nodes.label: Fold-level R2 Decomposition (SS_res / SS_tot)
nodes.rationale: Negative or unstable fold-level R2 is frequently caused by low within-fold target variance (small SS_tot) rather than poor predictions; decomposing R2 into its components makes that failure mode visible and justifies reporting pooled metrics.

nodes.label: Partial Dependence via iml Predictor/FeatureEffect
nodes.rationale: Wrapping every final model (XGB, GAM, GPR) in an iml::Predictor gives a model-agnostic PDP interface so one script produces comparable faceted PDPs for all three model families; the top-predictor list is optionally restricted to the robustly pruned covariates.

nodes.rationale: Builds or loads blockCV spatial or random folds keyed by data hash, block size, n_folds and exclude_regions; cached at output/cache/<cache_tag>_<hash>_folds.rds.

nodes.label: location_grouped_random CV
nodes.rationale: Groups rows sharing the same (longitude, latitude); prevents duplicate-coordinate leakage but not leakage from distinct locations in the same coarse raster pixel.

nodes.label: output/cache/ shared cache (folds, prediction grids)
nodes.rationale: Cached fold .rds and prediction_grid_cache_*.rds files are shared across runs to speed re-runs; deleting a cache file forces recomputation.

nodes.label: pixel_grouped_random CV (publication grouping)
nodes.rationale: Rows with identical raster-derived covariate vectors share a fold, so the model is never evaluated on inputs seen verbatim in training (common at ~4 km resolution). Strictly more conservative than location grouping; chosen as primary strategy for tuning, pruning and importance and reported in the paper.

nodes.label: random_split CV
nodes.rationale: Naive row split; duplicate covariates leak between train and test, so results are a highly optimistic baseline.

nodes.label: region_stratified_<m>m CV
nodes.rationale: Spatial blocks built within each ecoregion and folds combined so each fold keeps multi-region representation, reducing leave-one-region-out artifacts.

nodes.label: spatial_block_<m>m CV
nodes.rationale: Holds out whole spatial blocks to test extrapolation to new geography; not recommended as the main regime because of existing spatial clustering and a small dataset. Workflow is designed for gap-filling near sampled conditions, and spatial CV shows degradation when extrapolating.

nodes.label: Pixel-grouped cross-validation with multiple seeds
nodes.rationale: Samples sharing the same raster pixel are kept in the same fold to avoid spatial leakage; folds are re-instantiated under different random seeds to obtain a robust estimate of performance variance rather than a single split.

nodes.label: SHAP importance for covariate selection
nodes.rationale: Model-specific SHAP importances are used (in steps 2 and 3) to choose model covariates after removing highly-correlated variables, so that the final covariate set reflects each model's actual reliance on features rather than generic correlation.

nodes.label: Cached prediction grid
nodes.rationale: Predictions over the raster grid are cached once so maps, partial dependence plots, supplement figures and Python stock tables can be regenerated without re-running the model.

nodes.label: Pixel-grouped cross-validation folds
nodes.rationale: Folds are grouped by raster pixel so that samples sharing the same pixel never straddle train/test splits, preventing spatial leakage and optimistic CV metrics.

nodes.label: Central config / seed registry
nodes.rationale: A single registry of configuration and random seeds makes fold construction, held-out evaluation and across-seed diagnostics reproducible across stages.

nodes.label: SHAP-based covariate pruning
nodes.rationale: After a robust tune, SHAP importance is used to drop weak covariates, with an optional re-tune, to reduce model complexity and overfitting before evaluation.

nodes.label: Aggregated Carbon Stock C_N = sum_N A_N x rho_A
nodes.norm_label: aggregated carbon stock c_n = sum_n a_n x rho_a
nodes.rationale: National seagrass carbon stock is obtained by combining the per-EEZ areal extent with the unit-area carbon density, giving a per-nation total that is summed for the aggregate.

nodes.label: Unit-Area Carbon Density rho_A = rho_V x depth
nodes.norm_label: unit-area carbon density rho_a = rho_v x depth
nodes.rationale: Volumetric density must be integrated over sediment depth to obtain an areal stock density that can be multiplied by polygon area.

nodes.label: Assign Inferred Volumetric Carbon Density rho_V to Polygons
nodes.norm_label: assign inferred volumetric carbon density rho_v to polygons
nodes.rationale: Volumetric carbon density (rho_V) predicted by the trained model (GPR) is attached to each polygon based on its assigned species, replacing direct field measurements which are sparse.

nodes.label: Assign Seagrass Polygons to EEZs
nodes.rationale: Spatial join of seagrass polygons with Marine EEZ regions so that extent and carbon stock can be aggregated and reported per nation.

nodes.label: Assign to Species via eunis_code Field
nodes.norm_label: assign to species via eunis_code field
nodes.rationale: EMODnet seagrass polygons carry a EUNIS habitat code rather than a species name; mapping eunis_code to species is required so that species-specific carbon densities from the trained model can be attached to each polygon.

nodes.label: 0.13% of Polygons Discarded (insufficient information)
nodes.rationale: Polygons whose eunis_code cannot be resolved to a seagrass species lack the information needed to assign a carbon density; they are dropped rather than imputed. The loss is small (0.13% of polygons), so the trade-off favours data integrity over coverage.

nodes.label: Run-scoped output folder output/pixel_grouped_<seeds>/
nodes.rationale: Folder name is derived from robust_fold_seed_list (hyphen-separated) so each multiseed run's selection, tuning, evaluation, diagnostics and _run_metadata/pipeline_config_effective.rds are isolated and reproducible; multiseed_run_output_id is retained only for compatibility.

nodes.label: Centralized seed policy (single source of truth)
nodes.norm_label: centralized seed policy (single source of truth)
nodes.rationale: All seed defaults live in seed_registry inside pipeline_config.R rather than scattered across scripts; derived robust_fold_seed_list / eval_fold_seed_list are computed by get_pipeline_config() so downstream scripts keep existing names. Evaluation seeds are kept disjoint from the tuning pool. Frozen paper seeds are opt-in (use_paper_seed_registry = TRUE) only for paper-grade reproduction; exploratory reruns keep FALSE.

nodes.label: Robust multiseed CV evaluation
nodes.rationale: Reported performance depends on fold construction and seed; running tuning, SHAP pruning and evaluation across multiple fold seeds reduces split-variance artifacts. Evaluation uses a disjoint eval_fold_seed_list and outputs are written to a run-scoped folder named from the robust seeds.

nodes.norm_label: covariate pruning / variable selection (correlation filter + permutation + shap)
nodes.rationale: Correlation filter (|r| > 0.8) drops redundant covariates before per-model permutation importance (n_permutations default 1 because expensive; permutation_max_vars 15; feature_coverage 0.99) and optional SHAP selection (use_shap_per_model TRUE). Per-model sets are written to pruned_model_variables_perm.csv / pruned_model_variables_shap.csv.

nodes.label: Bathymetry Filter for Prediction Domain
nodes.rationale: The same bathymetry depth mask used elsewhere in the pipeline is applied to the prediction grid so maps only show predictions within plausible seagrass depth ranges.

nodes.label: Cached Prediction Grid (output/cache/)
nodes.rationale: Building the raster-derived prediction grid is expensive, so it is cached under output/cache/ and shared between the spatial prediction maps and the supplement figures.

nodes.label: Tuning sweep -> robust run seed handoff
nodes.norm_label: tuning sweep -> robust run seed handoff
nodes.rationale: Optional sweep selects robust seeds and writes chosen_seeds_latest.rds; the main driver temporarily overrides robust/eval seeds for that run when use_robust_seeds_from_tuning_sweep = TRUE. Reusing a sweep_<id> folder requires an identical planned subset manifest and effective sweep config, otherwise a new sweep id is allocated to avoid mixing incompatible runs.

nodes.label: pixel_grouped CV Regime
nodes.rationale: Observations sharing a raster pixel are kept in the same CV fold so spatially duplicated samples cannot leak between train and test.

nodes.label: Tuning Seed Count Sweep
nodes.rationale: Re-runs robust tuning, SHAP pruning and evaluation across increasing numbers of robust seeds (e.g. 1/3/5/10/15) to find where results plateau, so the main pipeline can justify its seed count; a new sweep_<id> folder is created whenever the subset manifest or effective config diverges so stale results are never silently reused. chosen_seeds_latest.rds lets the main driver optionally reuse the selected seeds (use_robust_seeds_from_tuning_sweep = TRUE).

nodes.label: Multi-seed Robustness Workflow
nodes.rationale: Covariate selection, hyperparameter tuning and evaluation are each repeated across multiple fold seeds so that decisions are not artefacts of a single random fold assignment; evaluation uses held-out fold seeds distinct from the tuning seeds and reports across-seed summaries. The run output folder is keyed by the seed list (output/pixel_grouped_<seeds>/) so runs with different seed sets never collide.

nodes.label: Exclusive Economic Zones (World EEZ v12, Marine Regions)
nodes.norm_label: exclusive economic zones (world eez v12, marine regions)
nodes.rationale: Used to attribute seagrass bed carbon to national territories.

nodes.label: Seagrass Essential Ocean Variable (EMODnet Seabed Habitats)
nodes.norm_label: seagrass essential ocean variable (emodnet seabed habitats)
nodes.rationale: Seagrass cover EOV enables national carbon stock calculation from predicted carbon density; eunis_id codes map reported species to core-data classes.

nodes.label: predict_model() (unified prediction dispatch)
nodes.rationale: Takes a saved model list from final_models/*_final.rds plus new data and optional se = TRUE; dispatches by model type so callers (maps, PDPs, point prediction) need no per-model code. Only GPR returns SE; others return se = NULL.
